control_description: Policies approved; not yet communicated or acknowledged
Guest privacy policy published but inaccurate on card storage; no security communication to vendors

control_description: Objectives and risk tolerance defined in POL-01 and P01
2026 risk assessment per SP 800-30 (P01)

remediation: Add front office and restaurant fraud scenarios to the risk assessment

First control assessment 2026-08 (P07); first PCI self-assessment with evidence due 2026-12-31; no ongoing monitoring
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M with owners and dates

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected in the SSP; most planned or partial
General IT controls partly in place (patching, anti-malware); lock server unsupported

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies approved; procedures not written

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Single sign-on and MFA for email and cloud; PMS users without MFA; flat network
gap: No MFA for PMS users; no segmentation

control_description: Manager-approved onboarding; no access reviews
Excess card-display permission; shared and stale accounts
gap: Least privilege and removal not working

control_description: Hotel lock system controls back office doors; server room keys unmanaged
Shredding bins with certificates; card forms and ID scans kept without limit

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Firewall blocks inbound; guest networks separated; vendor remote tools always on without MFA

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS on system connections; card numbers received by email and chat
gap: Card data in email and chat

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: Signature anti-malware on PCs; none on the lock server; alerts unmonitored

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: No vulnerability scanning or configuration monitoring

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: No security monitoring or log review
POL-03 defines triage; not yet operated
Runbook approved (P08); untested
No tested recovery for the lock server; backups in the production account
No change management; MSP changes firewall on email request
BIA done (P05); no IT contingency plan; hurricane plan excludes IT
remediation: IT section of the hurricane plan (P01 R-015)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: AOCs for PMS vendor and booking engine; gateway AOC old; none for channel manager, MSP, lock vendor; PMS vendor SOC 2 reviewed (Part B)
